action.prompt:
A spec task just finished. Append one entry to docs/kiro-log.md (create the file with a '# Kiro log' heading if it does not exist). Use this shape:

## <task number and title>
- Done: what changed (files, tests, properties), with counts.
- Kiro: which Kiro features this task leaned on (requirement IDs from the spec, property-based tests, hooks, steering) and how.
- Why it matters: one sentence.

Keep the entry short and factual: it is raw material for the Kiroween write-up. Do not change any other file. Then stage everything and commit with the message `task <number>: <title>`.
